desc:
🚗 Welcome to Steal and Drive!

See your dream car in traffic? Jump out and STEAL IT! Dodge cars, hit the nitro, and reach the getaway truck before you wreck your ride! 💥

🔥 How to Play:
🚘 Weave through traffic and hunt for rare cars
🦘 Jump from your car to steal a better ride
🚛 Escape in the getaway truck to keep your stolen car
💰 Display cars in your showroom to earn tips, or sell them for cash
🔧 Upgrade your rides and build your dream collection
🌎 Unlock new worlds with even better cars!

💸 YOUR CARS EARNS MONEY WHILE YOU’RE OFFLINE!
✨ Find rare mutations that make your cars worth even more!

🏆 Will you play it safe, or risk your ride for one last steal?

👍 Like and favorite the game to support us!
